## Documentation location

Link the file and section, or name the missing public surface.

## Gap

What is missing, stale, ambiguous, or contradictory?

## Verified source

Point to the current schema, script, generated example, contract, or source repo
that establishes the correct behavior.

## Proposed correction

Describe the smallest documentation change that would resolve the gap.

## Reader impact

Who is blocked or likely to make a wrong decision because of this gap?

## Public-safe check

- [ ] The report contains no secrets or private operational data.
- [ ] Examples use placeholders or repository-relative paths.
- [ ] Runtime claims were verified in the repo that owns them.
